Among dripping stalactites hundreds of blind mollock crawl, a species of bat that through eons of isolation and a blossoming 
underground ecology, adapted to a safe and fungal diet far from the night sky they once flew through. Venturing ever deeper into the 
tunnels, they slowly adapted to a flightless lifestyle within the acrid sulfur-based ecosystems, navigating through a chorus of echo 
locating chirps and a highly sensitive nose. Diminutive in size, their survival relies on their ability to breed quickly and swarm in large 
numbers. When predators do snatch them from their colony, many of the older members harbor a cocktail of lethal toxins in their 
blood from years of feasting on a variety of poison saturated fungus, causing the hungry carnivores to sicken and die.

Encountering Colonies of mollock can be found deep in 
the Umbrawells, often in cramped winding tunnels or high 
on colossal inner caves ceilings, feasting on the carpet of 
mushrooms above. If a Traveler is willing to climb or push into 
claustrophobic spaces, they can fi nd the hundreds strong colony 
of these blind mammals happily feasting away.
